_comment: What a hosted tenant may change of its own digest, and the caps it is held to (docs/decisions/0040-a-hosted-tenant-edits-its-settings-on-the-hosted-worker.md). Read by the hosted Worker's settings routes (workers/app/src/hosted_settings.js), its poll (tenant_buffer.js), and by the tenant's run container (src/cyris/adapters/hosted.py), which pins `provider`, `model` and `blank_settings` and clamps the article cap whatever the tenant's database holds. Constants: an operator-changeable cap is a later card. `writable_settings` is every settings key a tenant writes on /t/<tenant>/settings; the schedule is written through the registry, never as a settings row. `operator_keys` are what the operator alone sets, outside `settings`. `source_url` and `poll` are the rules a tenant's feed URL is held to when it is saved and at every hop of a poll; `poll.max_redirects` and `poll.max_feed_bytes` equal feed_check.py's MAX_REDIRECTS and MAX_BYTES (tests/test_hosted_settings_policy.py).
